title: In-process analysis core package
summary: Implemented first slice and architecture decision record for consuming Quality Studio analysis as a DLL: a publishable AgentOrchestrator.CodeQuality package, stable named-analysis API, real quality-cli consumer, clean HTTP-host boundary, rule-content boundary, and repository-extraction criteria.

responses.question: Is the core useful without the UI studio?
responses.answer: Yes. Agent Studio AGT-2655 pipeline steps, quality-cli, and CI are named standalone consumers.

responses.question: Should the core be extracted into its own repository now?
responses.answer: No. Keep it in the Quality Studio repository until independent cadence, public-repository policy, and cross-repository versioning benefits outweigh 0-PR integration costs.
